name: Bombora Burger Bar
description: The park's burger bar, serving beef and vegetarian burgers, fried chicken and hot chips. A quick, filling stop between slides, popular with families and groups who want a proper meal without leaving the water park.

items.name: Classic Beef Burger
items.description: Beef patty with cheese, lettuce, tomato and sauce

items.name: Veggie Burger
items.description: Plant-based burger with salad and sauce

name: Pizza Shack
description: A casual pizza stop with a choice of pizzas to share, ideal for families and groups. Pick up a hot slice or a whole pizza and refuel before heading back to the slides.

name: Village Bean Coffee House
description: The park's coffee house, serving coffee, drinks, sandwiches and cakes. A good place for parents to sit down with a hot drink and something sweet while the family enjoys the water.

items.name: Flat White
items.description: Espresso coffee with silky steamed milk

items.name: Iced Coffee
items.description: Chilled coffee with milk and ice

items.name: Toasted Sandwich
items.description: Hot toasted sandwich with a savoury filling

items.name: Slice of Cake
items.description: Sweet cake slice to go with your coffee
